title: Splinterbody Pursuer
text: Splinterbody Pursuer copies an operative's stance one heartbeat late and turns every feint into a collision. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Your reflection has already decided not to stop.

defeatReward.text: Splinterbody Pursuer is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
